verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gitea can bring in repositories from elsewhere: docs recommend migrating repositories from Gogs, one user migrated the TiDB repo to the Try Gitea service, and another uses repo mirroring. Nothing shows that issues, pull requests, reviews, or comments come along, and one user found migrating existing repos surprisingly difficult. missing for 10: documented import of issues, pull requests, reviews and comments, a list of supported source platforms (e.g. GitHub/GitLab), and hands-on corroboration of full-fidelity migration.
